newsitem.title: USA: Peerless outsourcing unit to hurt Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Peerless outsourcing unit to hurt Q2 net.

text.p: Peerless Group Inc said on Tuesday that its new outsourcing business will cut second quarter earnings by $0.03 to $0.04 a share.
The company said in a statement that it believes the potential for this business to be very strong.

Peerless reported second quarter earnings of $0.16 a share, but that was before it was taxed at the corporate rate, or $0.10 a share on a fully taxed basis. The company conducted its initial public offering October 1996.
Peerless said it opened a processing center in southeast Texas for the 10-month old outsourcing business.
